features.text: Battery/device profiles, charge accounting, battery replacement, coin-cell watches and improvised adapters.
Reserved energy transactions, rollback and uncertain-operation recovery.
Source/storage/load/network registries, appliance watt profiles and bounded infrastructure discovery.
Read-only generator observations and Weather event ingestion/consequence proposals.
Approved transparent battery mod icon; original thumbnail retained byte-for-byte.

limits: Generator electrical capacity and automatic external-storage charging remain unresolved. Event ingestion does not automatically damage equipment. Native SP/dedicated acceptance pending. G7 and stable G8 BLOCKED; optional integrations still need their own namespace updates.
